postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: FOOL! I'VE BEEN SUPPLYING RUNNING COMMENTARY TO EVERYTHING YOU DID. YOU THOUGHT I WASN'T WISE TO YOUR ESCAPE PLOT?

postload_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
postload_actions.text: I- I thought you missed some key bits -
postload_actions.cage: Uhhh, that is WRONG what you did, and you're a NOSY PARKER, and uh, SHAME ON YOU.

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: THE ALL-SEING DEMON LORD BALL MISSES NOTHING! AND NEITHER DO MY FISTS. CRUSHING-WISE. HERE, I'LL DEMONSTRATE.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: The elevator's stopped... there's no chance of escape!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: BWA HA HA! I BET YOU'D NEVER HAVE GUESSED, LISTENING TO MY VOICE THROUGH THAT PA SYSTEM, THAT MY VISAGE WAS SO GRISLY AND TERRIBLE!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Oh, so you were speaking through PA systems? You're not omnipresent?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: I DIDN'T SAY THAT. YOU SAID THAT. SHUT UP.

default_actions.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
default_actions.text: Please proceed to the elevator and return to normal duties. I'm not paying you to stand slack-jawed in a terrifying dungeon, you know.

lens.speaker: BAAL'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: WOW, THIS THING IS WORKING LIKE A CHARM! KINDA HAVING TROUBLE SEEING OUT THE EYEHOLE, THOUGH...

crowbar.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
crowbar.text: Baal? Why is my real boss inside of your face?
crowbar.cage: It's you. You're the rocket man.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: It is I, Tanaka, your employer! This cyclopean form is a paper mache contrivance. Perhaps I ought to explain.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: I recently came across a translated Western text - 'Dante's Ball Pit', I believe - and found within an exciting new management workflow!

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: I used it the basis for this involuntary anti-gambling, pro-synergy company training exercise.

crowbar.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
crowbar.text: Ball Hell - a training exercise? That's impossible! What about the cursed pachinko parlor in the ruins of ancient Babylon -

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Pachinko in Babylon? Ludicrous! Everyone knows Pachinko was invented by the Mayans.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: In any case, I happen to have your Synergy Level readings compiled on a spreadsheet...

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: According to our records, your performance on this exercise... was entirely perfect! You somehow evaded all Synergy Deaths!

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Your performance was truly Above Below Exceeds Expectations, my good man. I think this calls for a promotion!

crowbar.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
crowbar.text: R-really?

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Absolutely! You're promoted to Employee of the Week. Beginning next Thursday. Continuing into the following Friday. Congratulations!

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: According to our records, you experienced just 1 Synergy Death over the course of this exercise. Hmm! Mildly acceptable.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: According to our records, you experienced only [DEATHS] Synergy Deaths over the course of this exercise. Hmm! Mildly acceptable.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: As a reward, not only are you allowed to keep your job - you will hereby be awarded zero pay cuts! Yes, my generosity knows no limits.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: According to our records, you experienced [DEATHS] Synergy Deaths during this exercise. Hmm. I was prepared to be disappointed, but this...

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Still, don't think too much of it! This was merely a training exercise.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Any adjustments made to your pay based on these metrics will be hardly noticeable. Probably.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: According to our records, you experienced... [DEATHS] Synergy Deaths! Disgraceful! How dare you lack Synergy in my presence?!

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Still, I suppose it's out of the question to fire you based on a demon-themed training exercise.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Therefore I will simply change your job description to Collator of Garbage.

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Now, proceed to the elevator and return to normal duties. I'm not paying you to stand slack-jawed in a terrifying dungeon, you know.
* THWAK *

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Did you... did you just thwak me with a crowbar?

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: Let me make something very clear to you, my dear salaryman. If you EVER do that again -

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text: If you EVER produce a crowbar in my presence, ONE MORE TIME - if you give me ANY reason to associate you with crowbars WHATSOEVER -

crowbar.speaker: TANAKA-SAN
crowbar.text:
You will be standing in SEVERAL DIFFERENT 
 unemployment lines!!
* THWAK *

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: DAMMIT! I PAID GOOD MONEY FOR THIS GETUP. YOU'D THINK IT WOULD TAKE MORE OF A THWAKKING.

crowbar.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
crowbar.text: Tanka-san? Why is a tiny devil inside of your head?
crowbar.cage: Eyes, nose, skin, teeth. It's coming off.

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text:
I-IDIOT! I AM THE GRAND AND POWERFUL BAAL! 
 Y-YOU PROBABLY CAN'T SEE ALL MY AWE-INSPIRING MAJESTY IN THIS LIGHTING, IS ALL.

crowbar.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
crowbar.text: So you built a giant head and an exact replica of my boss? On the off-chance that I'd make it this far? Just to mess with me?

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: DUDE, I SANK MY WHOLE DAY INTO MESSING WITH YOU. MESSING WITH FUGITIVE SLACKERS IS THE ONLY FUN THING I GET TO DO HERE.

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: BUT DON'T THINK THAT EXONERATES YOU OF YOUR CRIMES! I MEAN, YOU'VE STAPLED MY POOR DEMONS... AWAKENED THE ANKH SPIRIT...

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: FED MY DOG... BROUGHT THE SUPPLY THIEF TO JUSTICE... FIXED THE BATHROOM, THE VENDING MACHINE, DRACHENROE'S COMPUTER...

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: MAN! IT KILLS ME TO SAY THIS. BUT BY SHIRKING YOUR DUTIES AND VOIDING MY IRONCLAD DISCIPLINE...

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: YOU'VE BECOME THE FIRST PRODUCTIVE EMPLOYEE I'VE EVER HAD!

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: TELL YOU WHAT, KID - I THINK YOU DESERVE A REWARD. IN FACT, I'LL GIVE YOU A CHOICE OF TWO!

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text:
YOU CAN GO BACK TO YOUR OLD LIFE... 
 OR STAY, AND WE CAN RULE BAAL HELL TOGETHER AS PALS. PICK YOUR POISON!
Leave Ball Hell
Exit Ball Hell
Depart Ball Hell
Stay, on the condition that it is opposite day

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: WOW! OKAY! YOU COULD'VE AT LEAST TAKEN A LITTLE LONGER TO ANSWER. YOU SPHERICAL ASS.

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: FINE. I'LL SEND YOU BACK TO YOUR OLD PACHINKO PARLOR. YOUR DEBT WILL BE FORGIVEN. YOU'LL STILL HAVE YOUR JOB.

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: THE QUESTION IS - WHERE DO YOU GO NEXT?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: PLANNING TO RUN OFF TO SOME TROPICAL BEACH VACATION? WELL, THE ONLY PALMS YOU'LL BE RESTING UNDER... IS THIS ONE!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THE PALM OF MY HAND. INSTEAD OF PALM TREES. AT THE BEACH. GOD, YOU'RE DENSE.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: ANYWAY. I'MA SQUISH YOU INTO A PALM SUNDAE!

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: NICE TRY... BUT MY FISTS OF FURY ARE IMMENSELY STRONG. AND IMMUNE TO NEARLY ANY WEAPON!

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: NICE TRY... BUT MY FISTS OF FURY ARE IMMENSELY STRONG. AND IMMUNE TO NEARLY ANY WEAPON!

collision_actions.epitaph: DOWN LOW - TOO SLOW! TO AVOID MY HAND. 'CAUSE I SKWOOSHED YOU. YEAH, THAT WAS ME! I DID THAT.
